title: Unbiasing symmetric monoidal categories in Lean
summary: We present a formalization in Lean 4, within the framework of the mathematical library Mathlib, of the unbiasing process for symmetric monoidal categories. This is realized by extending the data of a symmetric monoidal category to a Cat-valued pseudofunctor from the (2,1)-category of spans of finite sets, encoding tensor products of higher arities and their coherences.
